next.title: Drag & Drop
next.description: Drag and drop events, no longer blocked on a Winit release.

next.title: <body> and <html> events
next.description: Event listeners on the document's root elements.

next.title: Android app icons
next.description: App icon support in the CLI. Android back button support has already landed.

next.title: text-overflow
next.description: Ellipsis truncation for text that overflows its container.

next.title: DOM-based SVG
next.description: Direct DOM support for inline SVG. Enabling fast, animatable, stylable, interactive SVGs

next.title: <select>
next.description: Single-select drop-downs, including keyboard navigation and form submission.

next.title: Improved font matching
next.description: Weight, width and style ranges and support for unicode-range for @font-face rules.

next.title: Pluggable text backends
next.description: Moving Parley behind a compile-time text backend boundary, and adding a winkin backend.

backlog.title: Layout
backlog.description: position: sticky, table layout, the remaining contain values, and flow layout fixes.

backlog.title: Text layout
backlog.description: line-clamp and text-wrap-style.

backlog.title: Fonts
backlog.description: More reliable font fallback, and font-display.

backlog.title: Rendering
backlog.description: transform-box and better filter support on Vello backends.

backlog.title: Shadow DOM & Custom Elements
backlog.description: Shadow DOM with style encapsulation and slots, declarative shadow DOM, and a custom element registry.

backlog.title: Built-in elements
backlog.description: <select>, range, color and password inputs, <picture> and srcset, <base> and <meta> refresh.

backlog.title: Events
backlog.description: Animation, clipboard and beforeinput events, and events triggered by programmatic DOM changes.

backlog.title: Custom Widgets
backlog.description: Widgets that participate in layout and accessibility, pointer capture, and smarter paint invalidation.

backlog.title: Accessibility
backlog.description: Accessible text layout and input, and handling of accessibility events.

backlog.title: Inline box model
backlog.description: Margin, border and padding on non-atomic inline elements.

backlog.title: Table layout
backlog.description: Laying out CSS tables with Taffy's new table layout algorithm, instead of emulating them with CSS Grid.

backlog.title: Subgrid and Grid Lanes
backlog.description: CSS subgrid, and display: grid-lanes (masonry) layout via Taffy.

backlog.title: Web Animations
backlog.description: A new stylo_web_animations crate that runs CSS animations, CSS transitions and script animations.

backlog.title: Animation and transition events
backlog.description: Dispatching CSS animation and transition events.

backlog.title: Sizing keywords for min/max sizes
backlog.description: min-content, max-content and fit-content for min-* and max-* sizes.

backlog.title: aspect-ratio
backlog.description: aspect-ratio: auto && <ratio>, automatic minimum sizes, and transferring min/max sizes through the ratio.

backlog.title: IME composition
backlog.description: Composition events from IME input, underlined compositions, IME delete-surrounding requests, and IME state for inputs focused before the window is created.

backlog.title: Richer accessibility tree
backlog.description: Fuller support for accessible labels and descriptions, placeholders, tooltips from title, ARIA states and presentational roles, and incremental AccessKit tree updates.

backlog.title: Pointer capture and widget invalidation
backlog.description: Pointer Events pointer capture, and a WidgetCx that lets custom widgets request a redraw or relayout.

backlog.title: :has()
backlog.description: Enabling the :has() selector, with invalidation after state, attribute and DOM changes.

backlog.title: Form controls and selection
backlog.description: maxlength, focusing a clicked label's control, sizing inputs and textareas from size, cols and rows, and ::selection colors.

backlog.title: Touch fling
backlog.description: Android-style fling scrolling, with least-squares velocity tracking, spline physics and fling boosting.

backlog.title: DevTools Network panel
backlog.description: Recording page loads and network requests for the Chrome DevTools Network panel.

backlog.title: Blitz on the web
backlog.description: A wasm viewer for a single web page, and a wasm32 build of the Blitz Browser, for the website demo.

backlog.title: Layout performance
backlog.description: Parallel layout of sibling subtrees (prototype), plus caching of grid item placement and line breaking.

backlog.title: JavaScript embedding hooks
backlog.description: Hooks that let embedders extend Blitz's experimental Boa-based scripting.

completed.title: Devtools
completed.description: Inspect and edit the element tree, styles (including stylesheet rules), computed styles and box model with Chrome DevTools. Blitz apps can open DevTools themselves, using an embedded frontend.

completed.title: background-clip: text
completed.description: Text-clipped backgrounds, and -webkit-text-fill-color.

completed.title: text-shadow
completed.description: Painting text shadows.

completed.title: mix-blend-mode
completed.description: Initial mix-blend-mode and isolation: isolate support.

completed.title: Masks and SVG
completed.description: CSS masks use AnyRender mask layers (fixing mask-mode: luminance). SVG presentation attributes now map to CSS, and SVG <image> and <feImage> load external images.

completed.title: Fonts
completed.description: font-optical-sizing, falling back to the default font when no listed family is available, the @font-face font-stretch descriptor, skipping unsupported @font-face formats, and font emboldening tuned to match Safari.

completed.title: Float layout fixes
completed.description: Shrink-to-fit widths include floats, and floats and lines that don't fit beside existing floats move down to the next slot.

completed.title: Reversed scroll origins
completed.description: Negative overflow, such as in flex-wrap: wrap-reverse scroll containers, can be scrolled to.

completed.title: <details> :open
completed.description: The :open selector for open <details> elements.

completed.title: Presentational attributes
completed.description: Table cellspacing, cellpadding and valign, <font> face and size, and <hr> color, noshade and size.

completed.title: :focus-within
completed.description: Style elements that contain the focused element.

completed.title: text-indent keywords and word-break: break-word
completed.description: text-indent: hanging and each-line, and word-break: break-word, enabled by upgrading Stylo.

completed.title: aspect-ratio for replaced elements
completed.description: Replaced elements such as <canvas> derive their natural height from aspect-ratio.

completed.title: More robust page loading
completed.description: Stylesheets honour BOMs and @charset, non-UTF-8 pages decode lossily, and failed stylesheets no longer block rendering.

completed.title: Accessibility updates
completed.description: The AccessKit tree refreshes after DOM and focus changes, and images with an empty alt are treated as decorative.

completed.title: Parallel styling in apps
completed.description: Dioxus Native and the Blitz Browser now resolve styles on multiple threads.

completed.title: Faster style and layout
completed.description: Narrower restyle invalidation on DOM mutation, skipping animation lookups for elements that have never animated, cached class atoms, fast paths for simple inline layouts and empty flex containers, and mimalloc in the browser.

completed.title: Renderers
completed.description: The Blitz Browser now uses Skia by default, and wasm builds use the WebGL Vello Hybrid renderer.

completed.title: Stylo 0.24, Parley 0.13 and AnyRender 0.15
completed.description: Dependency upgrades, including Vello 0.12 and usvg 0.50.

completed.title: Winit 0.31 beta 4 and Wayland clipboard
completed.description: The clipboard now uses Winit's clipboard API, which adds native Wayland support.

completed.title: Dioxus 0.8 alpha
completed.description: Upgraded to Dioxus 0.8.0-alpha.3, with Dioxus Native synced from the Dioxus repository.

completed.title: Scripting APIs
completed.description: CSS properties as accessors on CSSStyleDeclaration, and URLSearchParams, in the experimental Boa-based scripting.
